entities.summary: The Pangwa are a Bantu ethnolinguistic group based in the Kipengere Range on the eastern shore of Lake Malawi, in the Ludewa District of Njombe Region in southern Tanzania. In 2002 the Pangwa population was estimated to number 95,000. The Pangwa language is a member of the Bantu family. Pangwa is a modern language with roots in Africa.
